description: Ministry of Public Administration and Management - Notify the Revision No. 2 of the Service Minute of Public Management Assistant's  Service published the Gazette Ex. No. 1840/34 of 11.12.2013
reasoning: This gazette content focuses exclusively on revisions to the Service Minute for Public Management Assistants' Service, specifically detailing educational qualifications, efficiency bar examination requirements, and training course specifications for public service officers. It deals with public service recruitment criteria, training requirements, and examination procedures, which falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) as it concerns public sector service conditions and administrative instructions rather than government structure/personnel changes or other specialized categories.
